_readme: Settings for this GACC. Edit from the website's Criteria tab.
name: Northern Rockies

Standard.description: Northern Rockies High Risk triggers as written in the 7-Day trigger criteria. Wind uses the 20 mph sustained wind from the wording; RH and Burn Environment thresholds start from the Southwest values.

triggers.name: Wind
triggers.description: Critical wind speeds and low relative humidity resulting in an elevated chance for significant fires and large fire growth, sustained winds are generally 20 mph or greater.

triggers.name: Lightning
triggers.description: Dry lightning with a coverage greater than 15% in combination with dry fuels that results in a greater than 20% chance of significant fires.

triggers.name: Burn Environment
triggers.description: An elevated chance of significant fires and potential for large fire growth due to either hot temperatures, instability, and wind or a combination of these factors.
